# gigahost_server_sizes (Data Source)

Lists every deployable server size as a flat list, optionally filtered by `platform`, `type`, or `region`. Same data as `gigahost deploy sizes`. For picking exactly one size, prefer `gigahost_server_size`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every deployable size; same data as `gigahost deploy sizes`.
data "gigahost_server_sizes" "all" {}

data "gigahost_server_sizes" "value" {
  type = "value"
}

output "value_size_slugs" {
  value = data.gigahost_server_sizes.value.sizes[*].slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `platform` (String) Only sizes on this platform (`cloud` or `metal`).
- `region` (String) Only sizes offered in this region (slug or name).
- `type` (String) Only sizes of this type slug, e.g. `value`.

### Read-Only

- `currency` (String)
- `sizes` (Attributes List) Deployable sizes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sizes))

<a id="nestedatt--sizes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sizes`

Read-Only:

- `bandwidth_gb` (Number)
- `category` (String)
- `cores` (Number)
- `memory_gb` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `platform` (String)
- `rate_hourly` (Number)
- `rate_monthly` (Number)
- `regions` (List of String) Region slugs the size is offered in.
- `slug` (String) Size slug for `gigahost_server.size`.
- `storage_gb` (Number)
- `type` (String)
